BiblicalUsage: Permanent is the word for the kingdom that stands: thy kingdom shall be sure unto thee, after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule, and He is the living God, and stedfast for ever, and His kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the sureness as the promise to Nebuchadnezzar and to Darius alike, that the kingdom of God does not fall with the kingdoms of men.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
